item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 20/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea in the next few days. Showers will be heavy at times. An area of low pressure will also exist over the trough of low pressure. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Sunday morning. The weather will be slightly cooler over the region early next week. With the broad trough of low pressure weakening, showers will ease off gradually over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Pulasan will transform into an extratropical cyclone gradually over the East China Sea today and tomorrow. The area of low pressure over the seas east of Taiwan will bring unsettled weather to the region in the next couple of days.
